description: This file provides a utility for subscribing to real-time game state updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) or polling, primarily for a Tic-Tac-Toe frontend. It manages the connection and fallback mechanisms, allowing components to receive updates or handle errors.

methods.name: subscribeToState({ code, onMessage, onError, intervalMs = 1200 })
